summary: Retest of Free Member Access gate scenarios S3, S4, and the newly requested S8. All three PASS. The main-agent fix (setBook(null) + setProgress(null) + setDownloaded(null) + setBookmarked(false) on [id, user] change in /app/frontend/app/book/[id].tsx, plus router.back()-preferred `goAfterAuth` in login.tsx and register.tsx) resolves the post-auth hydration race that failed in iteration_18. Confirmed flow: signed-out on /book/book-3d-retirement-income → gate visible (book-gate-primary + book-gate-secondary) → tap Sign In (S3) or Create Free Account (S4) → complete auth → land back on /book/book-3d-retirement-income with book-start visible and book-gate-primary gone, WITHOUT requiring a manual reload. S8 (new) also passes: after signing in on the book, navigating to Profile (tab-profile), tapping Sign out (profile-signout), and returning to /book/book-3d-retirement-income re-locks the page — book-gate-primary is visible again and book-start is gone. Deprecated packages detected: none. Non-blocking React Native web warnings still present in console (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) — same as iteration_18, out of scope for this retest.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/book/[id].tsx now correctly resets local state (book, progress, downloaded, bookmarked) at the start of the [id, user] useEffect, then refetches via cachedApi.book with both onCache and onFresh callbacks. This guarantees the previous locked payload cannot render after auth transitions. Solid fix.

/app/frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx and register.tsx goAfterAuth() now prefers router.back() when canGoBack() so we pop back to the exact detail-screen instance in the stack (avoids stacking duplicates). This also means the parent /book/[id] instance stays mounted and its [id, user] useEffect fires on user change — driving the refetch that renders book-start. Clean, symmetrical between login and register.

rca_of_issue: Fix confirmed. Two coordinated changes eliminated the race: (1) /app/frontend/app/book/[id].tsx now nulls out book/progress/downloaded/bookmarked at the start of the useEffect keyed on [id, user], so cachedApi.book(id).onCache can no longer surface a stale locked payload while the fresh authed response is in flight — the fresh onFresh callback is guaranteed to be the last setState. (2) login.tsx and register.tsx goAfterAuth() now prefer router.back() (falling back to router.replace(next)), which pops the auth screen off the stack and returns to the exact pre-existing /book/[id] instance instead of pushing a new one. That preserves the mounted BookScreen so its [id, user] useEffect fires on the user transition, triggering the refetch that populates book.pdf_url and renders book-start. S8 exercises the reverse: sign-out flips user back to null, the same useEffect fires, and the fresh /api/books/{id} returns locked:true → gate re-appears.
